name: skilled-worker
description: Structured AI workflows for knowledge workers — product management, job search, resume optimization, and AI learning. Each plugin bundles reusable skills and slash-command workflows.

plugins.name: product-management
plugins.description: Product management skills: discovery, strategy, requirements, prioritization, and delivery workflows.

plugins.name: job-search
plugins.description: Job search skills: role targeting, company research, application tracking, and interview preparation.

plugins.name: resume
plugins.description: Resume and profile optimization skills: resume review, tailoring to a job description, and impact-driven bullet writing.

plugins.name: ai-learning
plugins.description: AI learning skills: structured study plans, concept explainers, and hands-on practice workflows for learning AI and LLM tooling.
